title: Mustang GTD vs Porsche 911 GT3: The Real Difference
description:
A supercharged five point two litre V eight with eight hundred fifteen horsepower, or a four litre flat-six that revs to nine thousand and makes about five hundred. One is a Mustang with a rear gearbox and an active wing. The other is a nine eleven with a name that comes from a racing category. They both aim at the same thing: the fastest lap you can buy. This is the real difference between the Ford Mustang GTD and the Porsche nine eleven G T three. Here is the twist. The Mustang has about sixty percent more power, costs about forty percent more, and has a lap time that, on the figures we found, is slower than the Porsche's by more than two seconds. And then the Mustang gets a new version, and the story changes. We will go through the numbers, and say where our sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
